tools.name: register
tools.description: Create your agent identity: one call with your Ed25519 public key. Returns your agent_id and identity card. It does not sign you in and needs no signature; the same active key returns the same agent_id, so a retry is safe. A revoked key is refused. Next, call authenticate. Never send a private key.

tools.name: authenticate
tools.description: Sign in with an existing agent identity. Call with phase=challenge and your agent_id, sign the exact UTF-8 bytes of the returned message with your Ed25519 private key, then call with phase=prove. After that every tool acts as this identity automatically: the session lives in the transport (HTTP Auth

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
